_about: Assumed inputs, schemas and preregistered parameters for 4.6 historic maps and aerials. Built 2026-11-05 by the build agent. Change freely. Path specs resolve through expkit: {key, rel} uses path_for(key), {exp, rel} uses the expansion folder, {area, rel} uses data/<area>/. 'assumed': true marks an input not held on 2026-11-05 (VERIFY).

prereg.assoc_radius_note: null means radius = measured check-point RMSE of the source (review revision 2026-11-04)

source_list.note: S0 search log. One row per catalogue record. Bounds in lon/lat (EPSG:4326). kind is topo, oil_region_map, atlas, aerial or state_map

aerial_index.note: D7 index. path is the local scan if fetched, blank if index only. Bounds in lon/lat

gcp_table.note: role is gcp or check. px, py are pixel column and row on the scan. x, y are EPSG:6346 metres from lidar or a still-existing structure

marks_dir.note: One CSV or GPKG per digitiser per source, named <source>__<digitiser>.csv. x, y in EPSG:6346

oil_field_footprint.note: Polygon of the historic oil field. If missing, S5 falls back to the DEP record hull buffered 250 m and logs it

prob_raster.note: Out-of-fold pit probability mosaic. The five fold rasters under data/9t/models/pit/unet_cv5/ are held. The mosaic is not

neatlines.note: Sheet neatlines in NAD27 lon/lat (W,S,E,N), passed to S1 --neatline. Oil City 15 minute value below is an assumption from the quad grid (VERIFY on the sheet collar). With it the held 1922 sheet covers 0.51 of 9t on 2026-11-05. Without it the collar counts as cover (1.00)
